BiblicalUsage: The word is purple, the royal colour of Babylon, and it appears only in the night Belshazzar's kingdom falls. Whoever reads the writing on the wall will be clothed in purple and made third ruler, Daniel is offered the purple, and when he reads the writing, they clothe Daniel in purple the same night the king is slain.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the purple Belshazzar offered was the price of a kingdom already weighed and found wanting. Daniel wore it for one night, and the kingdom fell before morning.
